四、培训实施与现场管理

五、考核、复盘与数据统计
组织理论笔试、实操考核，判定培训效果，出具考核结果，对不合格人员安排复训。统计培训数据：参训人数、完成率、合格率、培训时长，形成培训报表。培训后回访调研，收集员工、主管反馈，持续优化培训方式与内容。
六、讲师与团队管理
选拔、培养内部兼职讲师（仓管、组长、老员工），制定讲师管理与激励规则。指导兼职讲师授课方法、课件使用，提升整体授课质量。
七、合规、档案与其他工作
建立完整培训档案：参训记录、考核成绩、培训课件、签到表、影像资料，做到可追溯。配合仓库完成质检、迎审、专项整改类培训工作。完成上级交办的其他临时培训相关任务。

1. Training System Development and Planning  
Develop annual and monthly training plans based on warehouse operations, job standards, and safety regulations, clearly defining training content, class hours, participants, and assessment objectives. Organize SOPs, operation manuals, and safety policies for each position to establish a tiered warehouse training system (new hires, current employees, team leaders, and specialized skills). Continuously update training materials—including courseware, textbooks, videos, and test questions—in response to business changes.

2. New Employee Onboarding Training  
Lead end-to-end onboarding training for new warehouse staff, covering company culture, site/warehouse rules and regulations, attendance policies, and behavioral standards. Deliver foundational operational training including warehouse area layout, product identification, inbound/outbound processes, scanning/system operations, and personal protective equipment usage. Assign mentorship programs, monitor hands-on learning progress, conduct regular reviews, and ensure rapid job readiness.

3. Ongoing Training for In-Service Employees  
Organize routine skill refreshers, process communications, and policy explanations to enhance overall operational proficiency and compliance. Conduct specialized training in areas such as inventory counting, sorting/packaging/loading/unloading, storage slot management, exception handling, and 6S management. Implement safety training covering fire safety, forklift and pallet truck operation, hazardous material handling, pedestrian-vehicle separation, and emergency drills. Provide targeted corrective training for inefficiencies, errors, or violations to reduce operational mistakes.

4. Training Execution and On-Site Management  
Independently organize various training formats including classroom instruction, hands-on practice, on-site coaching, case studies, and scenario simulations. Coordinate training venues, teaching aids, equipment, and instructors to ensure smooth implementation. Maintain training discipline, record attendance, classroom performance, and on-site issues, and promptly address any concerns.

5. Assessment, Review, and Data Reporting  
Conduct theoretical written tests and practical assessments to evaluate training effectiveness, issue evaluation results, and arrange retraining for underperforming individuals. Collect and analyze training data—such as participant numbers, completion rates, pass rates, and training duration—and generate comprehensive training reports. Conduct post-training follow-up surveys to gather feedback from employees and supervisors, continuously improving training methods and content.

6. Trainer and Team Management  
Select and develop internal part-time trainers (warehouse staff, team leaders, experienced employees), establishing clear management and incentive guidelines. Guide part-time trainers on teaching methodologies and courseware utilization to improve overall training quality.

7. Compliance, Documentation, and Other Responsibilities  
Maintain complete training records including participation logs, assessment scores, training materials, sign-in sheets, and audiovisual documentation to ensure traceability. Support warehouse operations in quality inspections, audits, and special improvement initiatives through relevant training. Complete other temporary training-related tasks assigned by superiors.
